en.t: Prince Genji went up to the palace at the hour of the monkey.

units.source_text: 他的童发梳成“总角”，左右分开，在耳旁挽成双髻，娇艳可爱。

en.t: His boyish hair was arranged in the agemaki style, parted to the left and right and tied into twin knots beside his ears, looking bright and charmingly lovely.

units.source_text: 现在要他改作成人装束，甚是可惜！

en.t: Now that he had to be changed into adult dress, it seemed a great pity.

units.source_text: 剪发之事，由大藏卿执行。

en.t: The cutting of his hair was carried out by the Minister of the Treasury.

units.source_text: 将此青丝美发剪短，实在不忍下手。

en.t: To cut short such beautiful glossy black hair was truly more than one could bear to do.

units.source_text: 此时皇上又记念起他母亲桐壶更衣来。

en.t: At that moment the Emperor once again remembered Genji's mother, the Kiritsubo Consort.

units.source_text: 他想：如果更衣见此光景，不知作何感想。

en.t: He thought that if the Consort could see this scene, who knew what she would feel.

units.source_text: 一阵心酸，几乎堕泪，好容易隐忍下去。

en.t: A pang of sorrow came over him, and he nearly shed tears, but with great effort he held them back.
